trigger: The planned 64 fixed-command replays matched their anchor images everywhere. A subsequent independent physical verification of direct block 2, public start 1, reported different live pixels after control 55. That verifier retained the tick but not the differing bytes.
budget: Eight independently launched local Docker containers, each replaying both complete 160-control anchors 16 times in fresh simulator processes. Save full natural frames, physical matches and all 32 query times on every replay. No camera, light, scene or pixel edit.
eligibility: Same full physics, input state, instruction, companion image, 1-4 changed pixels and maximum one RGB level as in protocol.json. No eligible time at or after first native goal can enter the treatment.
selection: One pair per public start and pre-/post-first-contact window. For start 1 before contact, test the observed tick 55 first; otherwise use earliest eligible query, then lowest replay ordinal. Do not use policy outputs or endpoints in selection.
branch_order: A then B on odd blocks, B then A on even blocks, reverse pair order on even blocks. Same controls before the branch, same two archived inputs except the naturally different camera, live feedback thereafter.
noise_test: Two fresh policy loads and reversed arm order. Compare the first command, first five and full chunk under each paired diffusion key. Only seed zero receives physical rollouts.
stop: If the changed bytes cannot be independently captured within the budget, report the original mismatch as unclassified and withhold action and outcome attribution.
